linkedin.body:
The hardest part of an AI portfolio can be choosing something small enough to finish.

Landed's catalog offers 85 project ideas, with difficulty levels, skills and learning references. My suggestion: pick one, build a working demo, and document how it fails as carefully as how it works.

A project with clear evidence gives people something concrete to evaluate.

https://withhammad.com/resources/ai-engineering-projects

Follow for practical AI engineering workflows. Presenter: my AI avatar.
